metadata.description: Small, sharp plugins for working with coding agents: where-were-we prompt navigation, the pr-review-cycle and review-council skills, and Xcode release automation

plugins.name: where-were-we
plugins.description: Timestamps your prompts in the transcript, adds up/down prompt navigation to the footer, and recaps where your last session left off

plugins.name: pr-review-cycle
plugins.description: Drive the full GitHub PR review → resolve → watch loop: summarize the PR, prioritize feedback, resolve threads, then watch for new reviewer activity. Prefer `npx skills add scarrillo/agent-plugins --skill pr-review-cycle` for the shorter /pr-review-cycle name.

plugins.name: review-council
plugins.description: Fresh-context code review by every coding agent CLI installed on your machine (Codex, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Antigravity), run in parallel and read-only; the lead verifies each finding against the code and proposes next steps. Prefer `npx skills add scarrillo/agent-plugins --skill review-council` for the shorter /review-council name.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Xcode release automation for Claude Code: SemVer bumps and tags, changelogs, decisions tracking and TestFlight notes for iOS/macOS apps
